title: Tuck in when they switch
titleKid: Ball on the other side? Move in
brief: They have the ball on your side of the pitch. Watch where it goes.
briefKid: They have the ball near you. Watch where it goes.
question: The ball has been switched to the far wing. Where do you go now?
questionKid: The ball is on the other side now. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: With the ball on the far wing, tuck in toward your centre-back and drop level with the line: the middle matters more than the empty space out wide.
takeaway.kid: When the ball is on the other side, move in toward the middle.

misconceptions.text: You stayed out wide guarding empty space, while the gap beside your centre-back is where they can hurt us.
misconceptions.textKid: Nobody is out wide, so come in toward the middle.

misconceptions.text: You tucked in but stayed high, so a ball over the top gets in behind you; drop level with the back line too.
misconceptions.textKid: Good, you came in, but drop back in line with your defenders.
